DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日の魚料理はこちらです。気になるものがあれば内容をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here are today's fish dishes. If anything interests you, I'll explain it.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で分けたいです。この煮魚は一匹でしょうか。それとも切り身ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人で分ける目的を伝え煮魚が丸ごとか切り身か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: We'd like to share between two people. Is this simmered fish a whole fish or portions?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain sharing between two and ask whether the simmered fish is whole or portioned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切り身を二つ盛っています。ただ、小さな骨が残ることがあります。お連れの方も魚がお好きですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It comes with two portions, but small bones may remain. Does your companion like fish too?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 好きですが、骨を取るのが苦手です。骨のない料理として出してもらうことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同行者が骨を取るのが苦手と説明し骨なし提供が可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, but they find removing bones difficult. Can it be served as a boneless dish?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your companion struggles with bones and ask whether boneless service is possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 煮魚は骨が残らないとは言い切れません。別の料理なら、骨を除いた魚のすり身を使う揚げ物があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can't state no bones will remain in the simmered fish. Another dish is fried fish paste made from fish with bones removed.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら、すり身の揚げ物の内容を教えてください。野菜も入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 代案の魚すり身の揚げ物の内容と野菜の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then please tell me what's in the fried fish paste. Does it contain vegetables too?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the contents and vegetables in the alternative fried fish paste. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 玉ねぎとにんじんが入っています。四個入りで、付け合わせは大根おろしです。辛い味付けはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It contains onion and carrot. There are four pieces, with grated daikon as a side. It isn't seasoned spicy.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 四個なら二人で分けやすいですね。大根おろしは別の皿にして、たれも別添えにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 四個を分ける判断を伝え大根おろしとたれの別添えを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Four pieces would be easy for us to share. Could the grated daikon be on another plate, and the sauce served separately too?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say four pieces are easy to share and request separate daikon and sauce. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、どちらも別にできます。揚げ物なので出来上がりには十分ほどかかりますが、よろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, both can be separate. Since it's fried, it takes about ten minutes. Is that okay?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十分なら待ちます。揚げ物を一皿、大根おろしとたれは別にして、取り皿を二枚お願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十分の待ち時間に同意し一皿と別添えと取り皿二枚を注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll wait ten minutes. One plate of the fried dish, with daikon and sauce separate, and two sharing plates, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to ten minutes and order one plate, separate sides and two sharing plates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご注文を承りました。取り皿を先にお持ちします。それでは、どうぞおくつろぎください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-IWAKUNI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your order is accepted. I'll bring the sharing plates first. Please relax.

DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどんな料理に使う魚をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of dish are you looking for fish for today?

DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人分の煮付けを作ります。丸ごとの魚と切り身で迷っていますが、家の鍋が小さいです。
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人分の煮付けで小さい鍋に合う魚の形を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm making simmered fish for two. I'm deciding between a whole fish and portions, but my pot at home is small.
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss a fish form suited to a small pot for simmering for two. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 鍋の大きさなら、こちらの切り身が扱いやすそうです。厚さが違うので、一緒に煮るものを選びましょう。
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-03.translation: For that pot size, these portions look easier to handle. Their thickness varies, so let's choose pieces to simmer together.

DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 厚さの近い切り身を二つ欲しいです。皮は取ったほうがよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 近い厚さの二切れを希望し皮を取るべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like two portions with similar thickness. Should I remove the skin?
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request two similarly thick pieces and ask whether to remove the skin. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 煮付けなら皮を付けたまま使う方法があります。作る料理の手順を確認してお選びください。
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-05.translation: For simmering, there are methods that leave the skin on. Check your recipe's steps when choosing.

DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 皮付きで選びます。骨が残っている部分は、売場で確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 皮付きで選び残った骨の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll choose skin-on pieces. Could you check where bones remain here at the counter?
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose skin-on pieces and request a check for remaining bones. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見える骨の位置は確認しますが、骨が全くないとは保証できません。食べるときにもお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check visible bone positions, but can't guarantee there are no bones at all. Please take care when eating too.

DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。家までは少し時間がかかるので、持ち帰りの保冷について相談したいです。
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰宅に時間がかかるため保冷を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. It takes a little while to get home, so I'd like advice about keeping it cold.
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss cooling because the journey home takes time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保冷用品の案内をご覧ください。商品表示の保存条件を守り、持ち帰ったら早めに冷蔵してください。
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please see the cooling-supplies guide. Follow the product's storage label and refrigerate soon after getting home.

DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 厚さの近い二切れを買います。保冷の準備をして持ち帰り、表示を見て冷蔵し、骨にも気をつけます。
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二切れ購入と保冷後の表示に沿う冷蔵及び骨への注意を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll buy two similarly thick portions. I'll prepare to keep them cold for the trip, check the label and refrigerate, and watch for bones too.
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy two portions and describe cooling, label-based refrigeration and bone precautions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの二切れをご用意します。ご相談ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll prepare these two pieces. Thank you for asking; please visit again.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 乗船のご予定ですね。まず、お持ちの予約画面を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.translation: You're planning to board. First, let's check your booking screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この予約です。外の風が強いので、予定どおり出るのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 予約画面を示し強風のため予定どおり出航するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.translation: Here's the reservation. The wind outside is strong, so I'd like to know whether it will depart as scheduled.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Show the booking and ask whether strong winds affect the scheduled sailing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今の表示では運航について確認中です。予約があることと、出航が決まっていることは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.translation: The current display says operation is being checked. Having a booking and departure being confirmed are separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 予約があっても待つ必要があるのですね。新しい情報は、どこで確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 予約と出航決定の違いを確認し情報源を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.translation: So I need to wait even with a reservation. Where can I check for new information?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Confirm the distinction between a booking and confirmed departure and ask for information sources. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 館内の案内表示と放送をご確認ください。係員にもお尋ねいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.translation: Please check the indoor information display and announcements. You can ask attendants too.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 表示を見ながら待ちます。手続きに備えて、予約画面以外に何を準備すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 表示近くで待つと伝え予約以外の準備物を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.translation: I'll wait while watching the display. Besides the booking screen, what should I prepare for the procedure?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say you will wait near the display and ask what to prepare besides the reservation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 予約に付いた案内の持ち物欄を見ましょう。本人確認などの条件も、この便の案内で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.translation: Let's look at the required-items section of your booking information. We'll check identification conditions and similar points in this service's guide too.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 持ち物欄を開きました。書類の名前を読み間違えたくないので、一緒に見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 持ち物欄を示し書類名の読み方の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.translation: I've opened the required-items section. I don't want to misread document names, so could you look with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Show the required-items field and request a check of document-name readings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、記載された名前を確認します。必要なものがそろったか、手続きを始める前に確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, we'll confirm the written names. Let's check you have everything before starting the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 持ち物を確認してから、案内表示の近くで運航の発表を待ちます。出航決定とはまだ考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 持ち物確認後に運航未確定のまま発表を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.translation: After checking the items, I'll wait near the information display for the operation announcement. I won't assume departure is confirmed yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: After checking required items, wait for announcements with operation still unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。発表後に手続きの案内をご確認ください。では、また後ほど。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-02-001-SHARED.translation: Please do. Check the procedure instructions after the announcement. See you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今日は箱の表示を見て仕分けます。魚を箱から出す作業は、まだ担当しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.translation: Today, sort by the box labels. Don't take on removing fish from boxes yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この箱の札が水でにじんでいます。魚の形から判断して、同じ列へ置いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: にじんだ魚種札を見た目で判断してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.translation: This box's tag has blurred from water. Can I judge by the fish's shape and put it in the same row?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask whether appearance can identify a blurred fish-species tag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 見た目で決めずに保留しましょう。判別できる箱の札と混ぜないことが大切です。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.translation: Let's hold it without deciding by appearance. It's important not to mix it with boxes whose tags are identifiable.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この一箱を確認待ちにします。ほかの箱を動かす前に、通路の水も片づけたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 一箱を保留し濡れた通路を先に片づけたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.translation: I'll hold this one box for checking. Before moving other boxes, I'd also like to clear the water from the passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Hold one box and ask to clean the wet passage first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 足元が滑りやすいですね。まず周りへ知らせて、清掃道具を用意しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.translation: The footing is slippery. First notify those around you and prepare cleaning tools.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 運んでいる人に声をかけます。濡れた箱を持つときの道具も、教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 運搬者へ注意を伝えると述べ箱運びの道具を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.translation: I'll speak to the people carrying things. Could you also teach me about the tools for carrying wet boxes?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Warn the carriers and ask about tools for carrying boxes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 箱用の台車を確認します。無理に抱えず、使い方の説明を受けてから運んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.translation: We'll check the box cart. Don't force yourself to carry them in your arms; receive instructions before transporting them.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 台車の使い方を教わるまでは、箱を持ち上げず表示の確認だけを続けてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 台車説明前は持ち上げず札確認だけをしてよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.translation: Until I'm taught how to use the cart, may I continue only checking labels without lifting boxes?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Before cart instruction, avoid lifting and ask to continue only label checks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ええ、安全な位置から読める札を確認してください。にじんだ札はこちらで照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, check readable labels from a safe position. We'll match the blurred tag here.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 読める札だけ確認し、にじんだ一箱は混ぜません。運搬は台車の説明を受けてからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 読める札を確認し不明箱保留と説明後運搬の方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.translation: I'll check only readable labels and won't mix in the one blurred box. I'll transport boxes after receiving cart instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: State the plan to check readable tags, hold the unknown box and transport only after instruction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: それで進めましょう。区切りがついたら報告に来てください。では、また後で。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-03-001-SHARED.translation: Let's proceed that way. Come and report at a stopping point. See you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: このラインは今、点検中です。今日は横の棚で部品の数量を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.translation: This line is under inspection now. Today, check part quantities on the shelf beside it.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 盤面に点検中の札があります。機械が止まっていても、私が電源を入れてはいけないということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 点検札のある停止機械を自分で起動してはいけないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.translation: There's an inspection tag on the panel. Does that mean I mustn't turn on the power myself even though the machine is stopped?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Confirm you must not start a stopped machine with an inspection tag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、点検の担当者が管理しています。札や操作盤には触れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.translation: Correct, the inspection staff controls it. Don't touch the tag or control panel.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 棚の部品を数えるために、ラインの内側へ入る必要がありそうです。今は入らず相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 数量確認に内側立入りが必要そうなので入らず相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.translation: It looks as though I'll need to enter inside the line to count the shelf parts. I'd like to ask rather than entering now.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask without entering because counting appears to require entry inside the line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 内側へは入らないでください。外から届く分だけでなく、作業範囲自体を担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.translation: Don't go inside. We'll check the work scope itself with the staff member, not only what is reachable from outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: では数量確認もいったん待ちます。先ほど別の人が札を見ずに近づいていましたが、声をかけてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 作業を待つと伝え札を見ずに近づく人への声かけを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.translation: Then I'll pause the counting too. Earlier someone approached without seeing the tag; may I tell them?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Pause work and ask whether to alert someone approaching without noticing the tag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 危険な場所へ追いかけず、安全な位置から点検中だと知らせてください。私も担当者へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.translation: Don't follow them into danger. Tell them it's under inspection from a safe position. I'll contact the staff member too.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 安全な位置で知らせます。点検が終わったという話を聞くだけでは、作業を再開しないほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 安全位置で知らせると述べ伝聞だけで再開しない判断を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.translation: I'll tell them from a safe position. Just hearing someone say inspection is finished isn't enough to resume, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Notify from a safe position and confirm not restarting on hearsay alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: そのとおりです。責任者の指示と作業範囲の確認を待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.translation: Exactly. Wait for the supervisor's instructions and work-scope confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 人づての話では再開しません。棚への立入り範囲も含めて、責任者から指示を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 責任者から立入り範囲を含めた指示を受けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.translation: I won't resume based on secondhand information. I'll receive instructions from the supervisor, including where I may enter to reach the shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Receive supervisor instructions including the permitted entry scope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: よろしくお願いします。待機場所でお待ちください。では、また指示のときに。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-04-001-SHARED.translation: Please do. Wait at the waiting area. We'll speak again when instructions are ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今日の体験は、この小さな木の飾りを仕上げます。刃物を使う工程もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.translation: Today's activity is finishing this small wooden ornament. Some steps involve a blade.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 刃物は使ったことがありません。最初から自分で削る必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 刃物未経験なので自分で削る必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.translation: I've never used a blade. Do I need to carve it myself from the beginning?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say you are inexperienced with blades and ask whether you must carve yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: いいえ、難しい工程は私が担当できます。お客様はやすりで整える工程から始められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.translation: No, I can handle the difficult steps. You can start from shaping with a file.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: それなら、削るところは見学して、やすりの工程だけ体験したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 刃物工程は見学しやすりだけ体験したいと選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.translation: Then I'd like to watch the carving and participate only in the filing step.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Choose to watch the blade work and participate only in filing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 承知しました。やすりも材料を固定して使います。まず手の位置を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.translation: Understood. Filing also requires the material to be secured. First, look at the hand positions.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 木を押さえる手は、やすりが動く方向から離すのですね。固定が緩んだらどうしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 手の位置を確認し固定が緩んだ場合の対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.translation: So the hand holding the wood stays away from the file's direction of movement. What if the fastening loosens?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Confirm hand position and ask what to do if fastening loosens. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 手で無理に押さえず、作業を止めて呼んでください。固定具を私が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.translation: Don't force it down by hand; stop and call me. I'll check the clamp.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 止めて呼びます。仕上がりに深い傷が残っても、力を入れて削り続けないほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 停止して呼ぶと述べ深い傷を力で削るべきか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.translation: I'll stop and call. If a deep scratch remains in the finish, should I avoid applying force and continuing to file too?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say you will stop and call and check whether to avoid forceful filing of a deep scratch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、傷の状態を見てから方法を選びます。力で解決しようとせず、見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, we'll choose a method after looking at the scratch. Show it to me rather than trying to solve it by force.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 刃物は見学にして、固定した木にやすりをかけます。緩みや深い傷があれば止めて見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 刃物見学とやすり体験及び異常時停止報告を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.translation: I'll watch the blade work and file the secured wood. If it loosens or has a deep scratch, I'll stop and show you.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Describe blade observation, filing participation and stopping to report problems. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: その手順で進めましょう。準備ができたらお呼びします。それでは、またすぐ後ほど。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-05-001-SHARED.translation: Let's follow that procedure. I'll call when ready. See you again very shortly.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お食事をお探しですか。温めて食べる商品もこちらにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.translation: Are you looking for a meal? Products to heat before eating are here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 夜勤が終わったところです。温かいものを食べたいですが、飲み物も含めて予算内にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 夜勤後の温かい食事と飲み物を予算内で希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.translation: I've just finished a night shift. I'd like something warm, but want to stay within budget including a drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Request a warm meal and drink within budget after a night shift. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この二つなら、それぞれの価格を表示で確認できます。どちらも温め方は包装に書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.translation: For these two, you can check each price on the display. Heating instructions are on both packages.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 量が少ないほうを選びます。この飲み物を足した合計も、会計前に確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 少量の商品を選び飲み物込み合計を会計前に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.translation: I'll choose the smaller quantity. Can I check the total including this drink before paying too?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Choose a smaller item and ask to check the drink-inclusive total before payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、商品をそろえたら合計を確認できます。温めについてもご希望を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, once the products are together, we can check the total. We'll also ask what heating you'd like.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 合計が予算に収まるなら買います。家に電子レンジがないので、この店で温められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 予算内なら購入と伝え家にレンジがないため店の温め対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.translation: I'll buy if the total fits my budget. I don't have a microwave at home; can you heat it in this shop?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say you will buy within budget and ask about in-store heating because you lack a microwave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この場面では温めの対応ができます。包装の手順を確認して、担当スタッフが対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.translation: In this scenario, we can heat it. The staff member will follow the packaging procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。持ち帰るまで少し歩くので、熱い容器を持つときの注意も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 歩いて持ち帰るため熱い容器の扱いの注意を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.translation: Thank you. I'll walk a little before getting home, so I'd also like precautions for holding a hot container.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask about handling a hot container for walking home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 熱い部分を直接触らないようにしてください。容器の注意表示を確認し、袋に入れてお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.translation: Don't touch the hot parts directly. We'll check the container's caution label and hand it over in a bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 合計を見てから購入を決めます。予算内なら温めをお願いし、袋を持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 合計で購入判断し予算内なら温めと袋を依頼すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.translation: I'll decide to buy after seeing the total. If it's within budget, I'll ask for heating and carry the bag home.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Decide based on the total and request heating and a bag if within budget. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらで合計を確認しましょう。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-06-001-SHARED.translation: Understood. Let's check the total here. Take care going home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今日はいつもの時間ですが、始める前に体調を伺います。変わったことはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.translation: It's your usual time today, but first I'll ask about your condition. Has anything changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 昨夜あまり眠れず、今日はいつもより疲れています。普段と同じ運動をするのが不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 睡眠不足と普段より強い疲れ及び運動への不安を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.translation: I didn't sleep much last night and feel more tired than usual today. I'm worried about doing my normal exercise.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Explain insufficient sleep, unusual fatigue and anxiety about exercise. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: その状態を担当者に伝えます。今は座ってお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.translation: I'll tell the responsible staff member. Could you sit and wait for now?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 座って待ちます。歩く練習は短くすればよいのか、自分では判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 座って待つと述べ短時間運動の判断ができないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.translation: I'll sit and wait. I can't judge myself whether making the walking practice shorter would be enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Sit waiting and say you cannot decide on simply shortening exercise. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 内容や時間は専門の担当者が確認します。私から勝手に短くして始めることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.translation: The specialist will check the content and duration. I won't simply shorten it and start it myself.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 担当者に、睡眠不足と疲れの両方を伝えてください。今日はまだ運動を始めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 睡眠不足と疲れ及び未開始を担当者へ伝えるよう依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.translation: Please tell them both the lack of sleep and fatigue. I haven't started exercise today yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask the specialist to be told about insufficient sleep, fatigue and not having started. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: その二点と、まだ始めていないことを伝えます。待っている間に具合が変わったら知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.translation: I'll tell them both points and that you haven't started. If your condition changes while waiting, let us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: もし疲れが強くなったら、立たずにここから声をかければよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 疲れが強まったら座ったまま呼ぶ方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.translation: If the fatigue gets stronger, should I call from here without standing?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Check how to call while seated if fatigue increases. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、ここから呼んでください。無理に移動せず、その時の様子を伝えていただければ対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, call from here. Don't force yourself to move; tell us how you are then and we'll respond.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ここで座り、担当者に確認してもらってから今日の内容を決めます。変化があればすぐ呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 座って専門担当確認後に内容を決め変化時に呼ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.translation: I'll sit here and decide today's activity after the specialist checks. If anything changes, I'll call immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Stay seated, decide activity after the specialist's check and call if anything changes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当者へ連絡してまいります。それでは、また後ほど。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-07-001-SHARED.translation: Understood. I'll go and contact the staff member. See you shortly.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 通知についてのご相談ですね。通知の表題と、確認したい箇所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.translation: You're asking about a notice. Please tell me its title and the part you want checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 資料の提出について書かれています。去年の給与の紙を持ってきましたが、これで足りるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 資料提出通知に去年の給与資料が足りるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.translation: It mentions submitting documents. I brought last year's salary paper, but would like to know whether that's enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask whether last year's salary document meets the document-submission notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: まず通知がどの年の資料を求めているか読みましょう。この欄の対象年と、お持ちの紙の年を比べられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.translation: First, let's read which year's documents the notice requests. Can you compare this applicable-year field with the year on your paper?

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 比べると一年ずれていました。家に別の年の紙があるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 対象年と持参資料が一年違うと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.translation: Comparing them, they're one year apart. I may have the paper for a different year at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Report a one-year difference between the requested year and brought document. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: では、この紙で足りるとは判断できません。対象年に合う資料について、通知の担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.translation: Then we can't judge this paper sufficient. Let's ask the notice's responsible staff about documents matching the requested year.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ここでそのまま提出するのではなく、担当へ聞くのですね。連絡先はどの欄ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 提出せず担当に聞くと確認し連絡先欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.translation: So I shouldn't submit it here as it is; I should ask that staff member. Which field has the contact details?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Confirm you will ask rather than submit and ask where the contact is listed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 下の問い合わせ欄です。通知の照会番号も伝えると、担当が内容を確認しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.translation: The inquiry field below. Giving the notice's reference number also helps the staff check its contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 必要な紙が見つからない場合も、その番号を伝えて相談してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 資料が見つからないとき照会番号で相談できるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.translation: If I can't find the needed paper, may I also use that number to ask for advice?
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask whether the reference number can be used to discuss missing documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、何が手元にあり、何が見つからないかを具体的に伝えてください。提出期限も通知で確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, tell them specifically what you have and what you can't find. Check the submission deadline on the notice too.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 対象年と期限を控え、家の資料を探します。見つからなければ照会番号を添えて担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 対象年と期限を控え資料を探し不足なら担当へ相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.translation: I'll note the applicable year and deadline and look through my documents at home. If I can't find it, I'll ask the staff member with the reference number.
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Note the year and deadline, search documents and ask the staff if anything is missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ご確認のうえお進めください。窓口でのご説明は以上です。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YMC-SHIMONOSEKI-08-001-SHARED.translation: Please check before proceeding. That's the end of our counter explanation. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この箱の部品は表面の傷を確認します。検査台の見本を見てから始めましょう。
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-01.translation: Check the parts in this box for surface scratches. Let's look at the inspection bench's sample before starting.

DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見本には線状の傷がありますが、この丸い点も同じ判定基準で見てよいですか。
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見本の線状の傷と丸い点を同じ基準で判定してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-02.translation: The sample has a line-shaped scratch. Can I assess this round spot using the same criteria?
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a sample's line scratch and a round spot use the same criteria. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 丸い点は別の項目にあります。こちらの写真と説明を見てください。見本にないものは保留にします。
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-03.translation: Round spots are in a different category. Look at this photo and explanation. Hold anything not covered by the sample.

DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この点は写真より薄くて判断できません。保留として、どの容器に入れればよいですか。
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真より薄い点を判断できず保留にする容器を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-04.translation: This spot is fainter than the photo and I can't judge it. Which container should I put it in on hold?
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Unable to assess a spot fainter than the photo, ask which hold container to use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 黄色い保留用の容器へ入れてください。良品の容器には入れません。部品の番号も控えましょう。
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-05.translation: Put it in the yellow hold container, not the accepted-parts container. Let's note the part number too.

DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号はＡ十二です。保留の記録には、薄い丸い点が一か所あると書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: Ａ十二という番号と薄い丸い点が一か所という記録内容を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-06.translation: The number is A twelve. Should the hold record say there is one faint round spot?
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the number A twelve and the description of one faint round spot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、見えた状態を書いて、判定欄は保留にしてください。記録に検査した時刻も入れます。
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, write what you saw and mark the assessment as on hold. Include the inspection time in the record too.

DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 時刻も記入します。同じ箱の残りを調べる間、この保留品の判定は誰に頼みますか。
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時刻も記入すると伝え残りを調べる間の保留判定の依頼先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll enter the time too. While I check the rest of the same box, whom should I ask to assess the held item?
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Record the time and ask who assesses the held item while you inspect the remainder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 私から検査責任者へ確認を頼みます。あなたは同じ基準で残りを調べ、迷う品は番号ごとに分けてください。
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll ask the inspection supervisor. Check the rest by the same criteria and separate uncertain items by number.

DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 残りを同じ基準で調べます。迷う品は番号を控えて保留にし、良品には混ぜません。
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同じ基準で残りを検査し迷う品は番号を記録して良品と分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the remainder using the same criteria. I'll record uncertain items' numbers, put them on hold and not mix them with accepted items.
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Inspect the remainder by the same criteria and record and separate uncertain items from good ones. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お願いします。判定が返ってきたら声をかけます。それでは、作業へ戻りますね。
DLG-SC-YMC-UBE-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. I'll tell you when the assessment comes back. I'm returning to work now.
